text:
Marta (People Ops): Heads-up: a few review forms are late due to LOA returns and team transfers. Proposing reviewer SLA = 5 business days; managers can request one 7-day extension via people-ops form. Anything beyond needs Director sign-off. Thoughts?

Ethan (Eng Manager): +1. Can we let managers mark "condensed review" when they can only provide bullets? Calibrations get stalled otherwise.

Priya (People Ops): Yes — we'll add a "Condensed review" checkbox with required note explaining gaps. That flags the packet in calibration.

Noah (Recruiter): New-hire rule? Last cycle a few <60d hires slipped into calibration. Should be explicit: <60 days = onboarding checkpoint only.

Leah (Director People): Agreed. Add that to the ops doc and require a 2-3 bullet onboarding note for context. Also ask managers to surface exceptions to calibration leads by Friday.

Ravi (SWE): Quick ask: can extension counts be visible on Review Ops dashboard per team? Useful for retro.

Marta (People Ops): Yes — adding "Extensions requested" metric with reason buckets (LOA/caregiver/new-hire/team-change). We'll publish the updated flow + template tomorrow morning. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
